name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(door_open) makes opening the door the hard goal; 'then, if possible' makes picking up the box soft (Existence(target_picked_up) soft), so door_open is lone and keeps its hard Existence; Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) is the hard order stated by 'then'.

machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up, u1) -> -100.694
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up, u2) -> 7
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up, u2) -> 12
